title: Guard deleteService against any name outside the qualify prefix
summary: One-line guard so scripts/qualify-packaged.ts deleteService refuses a name without the opum.ward.qualify- prefix.
description: opum-doc NIT on #157: deleteService deletes every credential-store item under a service by name. Today both callers pass qualify-prefixed services, but nothing stops a later caller passing opum.ward. Add a guard inside deleteService that throws for any name not beginning opum.ward.qualify-, and a test or a check that proves the refusal (a positive control that a qualify name is accepted). Low priority; found in the WCLI-15 review, no re-review needed.
plan: 1. Add assertQualifyService to scripts/build.ts (throws unless name starts with the qualify prefix).
2. Call it first in deleteService in scripts/qualify-packaged.ts.
3. Test the refusal for opum.ward and other names, and a positive control for a qualify name; check deleteService calls it before any spawn.
implementationNotes: Built fresh under DEC-226 (the earlier DeepSeek build, #160, was closed unmerged; this build does not use it). Floor work, DEC-182: security label, Sonnet.

Proof: bun test test/qualify-build.test.ts 5 pass; refusal for opum.ward, opum.ward.other, bare prefix, empty and a prefix not at the start; positive control for newQualifyService() and a hand-written qualify name. Mutation: removing the guard call turns only the order test red. Deviation, noted for review: a name equal to the bare prefix (empty suffix) is also refused. DEC-226.
finalSummary: deleteService now refuses any service name not beginning opum.ward.qualify- (assertQualifyService in scripts/build.ts, called before any security spawn); landed in #161. Built fresh under DEC-226; opum-doc Opus security review at 1692c05e4821291f53d1ac069b90686d5b298df0 recorded on ODOC-488 approved it and confirmed refusing the bare prefix.
